title: Morning checklist — QBR prep & renewal nudges (personal)
content:
Quick personal scratchpad for the day — mix of items to triage before 3pm QBR. 

Top priorities (today):
- 09:15: Run through slides + talking points for ACME QBR (re-run perf numbers from last 7 days).
- 10:00: Ping Eng (Priya) about SDK regression impacting streaming tokens (JIRA: CS-982) — need ETA for patch.
- 11:30: Call with Finance to confirm renewal numbers for BetaRetail (renewal window: 2026-04-02). Confirm discount exceptions logged.

Account-specific notes:
* ACME Corp (QBR, 15:00):
  - Bring recent latency p50/p95 chart (last 7 days) and top 3 error traces.
  - Ask about plans to move 2 non-prod workloads to Dedicated (they asked cost comparison last week).
  - Evidence: support ticket #54321 (rate-limit spikes on 2026-03-08) — show mitigation steps applied.
  - Open question: Are they comfortable with Canary fallback to smaller model for peak windows? (Need decision)

* BetaRetail (renewal):
  - Renewal window in 21 days. Revenue: $145k ARR.
  - Slack convo with buyer (Matt) stalled — message template below to send today.

Support follow-ups:
- Escalations: two open cases older than 48h (ACME #54321, Retail #54899). Prioritize ACME due to QBR.
- Postmortem draft for 2026-03-08 rate-limiter incident — add timeline + RCA bullets before EOD.

To-do (checklist):
[ ] Finalize ACME slide (perf table + cost delta)
[ ] Send BetaRetail renewal nudging email (template ready)
[ ] Confirm Eng PR merge (PR: github.com/redwood/infra/pull/329)
[ ] Update QBR agenda on Confluence (link: https://redwood.atlassian.net/wiki/spaces/CS/pages/12345)
[ ] Set reminder to follow up with legal for BetaRetail SOW amendment

Email/Message drafts (quick copy):
- To Matt (BetaRetail):
  Subject: Quick check — renewal window & upcoming savings
  Hi Matt — wanted to confirm timing for your renewal (early April). We have a proposal that could reduce unit token cost ~12% if you commit to Dedicated. Can we schedule 20m this week?

- To Priya (eng):
  Short: Priya — can you share ETA on the streaming patch for token regression (CS-982)? Need to communicate to ACME before the QBR at 3pm.

Notes to self / reminders:
- Keep QBR slides to 12 minutes + 10 mins for customer questions.
- Record the session (enable recording in calendar invite).
- After QBR: 30m follow-up to capture action items in JIRA and assign owners.

Open questions / blockers:
- Legal turnaround for SOW amendment (BetaRetail) — typically 5–7 business days; can we expedite? (Who to cc?)
- ACME decision on Canary fallback — need a yes/no so we can prepare playbook.

Random scratch thoughts (brain dump):
- Could propose a small pilot: move 10% of BetaRetail traffic to Dedicated for 2 weeks and report cost/latency delta.
- Consider a standardized "pre-QBR checklist" doc we send 48 hours prior to customers to reduce ad-hoc prep.

Links / refs:
- Support ticket ACME: https://support.redwood.ai/t/54321
- PR: https://github.com/redwood/infra/pull/329
- Confluence QBR template: https://redwood.atlassian.net/wiki/spaces/CS/pages/12345

End of scratchpad — keep short notes here during the day and copy to official QBR doc afterwards.
